instruction: Sort the invoices by the month they were paid. On the Desktop, make a folder named 'march_payments' and place all invoices paid in March 2022 inside it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires analyzing the bank statement to identify which invoices were paid in March 2022. Based on the bank statement data (period 03/01/2022 to 03/31/2022): (1) Invoice #243729 (Staples) was paid on 3/1/2022, (2) Invoice GES-20220215-82 (Solar Panels) was paid on 3/15/2022, (3) Invoice TII-20220301-90 (Laptops) was paid on 3/20/2022. The evaluator checks if the march_payments folder contains all 3 invoice files that were paid in March according to the bank statement.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) if march_payments folder contains exactly the 3 invoices paid in March 2022 (invoice TII-20220301-90.pdf, Invoice # GES-20220215-82.pdf, Invoice # 243729.pdf) AND these files are removed from Desktop (moved, not copied). Score 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: (1) march_payments folder exists and contains exactly the 3 expected invoice files, (2) files were moved (not copied) by checking they are absent from Desktop source folder

Edge cases handled correctly: if march_payments folder doesn't exist, getter returns empty list and metric correctly returns 0.0
